# Event

> Timed live-ops events (start / end windows) with a scheduler loop.

- Package: `Event` · Category: Progression & live ops
- Starts at server boot: **yes, whenever installed** (it has work to do before its first call)
- Installing it also installs: nothing else (only Core)
- Check it is installed: `GaxiaServer.IsInstalled("Event")` (server) / `Gaxia.IsInstalled("Event")` (shared/client keys)

## `GaxiaServer.Event`

- Runs: **server only (Script / server ModuleScript)**
- Source: `src/ServerStorage/Gaxia_Packages_Server/Lib/EventService.lua`

Get it:

```lua
local GaxiaServer = require(game:GetService("ServerStorage").Gaxia_Packages_Server)
local Event = GaxiaServer.Event
```

### Signals

Connect with `:Connect(function(...) end)`; the parameters are the payload types, in order.

- `Event.OnEventStart` — `Signal<string, any>`
  (eventId, data) once when an event's window opens (data = its EventDef.Data)
- `Event.OnEventEnd` — `Signal<string, any>`
  (eventId, data) once when an event's window closes
